S001.title: OpenAI Frontier Governance Framework
S001.claim: Framework covers cyber offense, CBRN risks, harmful manipulation, loss of control.

S002.title: OECD Artificial Intelligence markets (2026)
S002.claim: Structural concentration risks persist; incumbents may become entrenched especially in hardware/data.

S003.title: Oxford/FAccT 2025 Uber algorithmic pay and pricing
S003.claim: 1.5m trips/258 drivers; pay decreased, platform cut increased, predictability worsened after dynamic pricing.

S004.title: ILO Algorithmic management in the workplace
S004.claim: Algorithms organize, assign, monitor, supervise and evaluate work.

S005.title: ILO AI-driven surveillance and loss of autonomy
S005.claim: AI surveillance/work intensification/reduced autonomy linked to psychosocial risks.

S006.title: EEOC FY2024 Annual Report — Mobley v. Workday
S006.claim: Court found plaintiff plausibly alleged Workday could be potentially liable as agent of employers; merits not resolved.

S007.title: ACM SIGecom — Designing Consent
S007.claim: Randomized consent-interface field experiment; hiding options behind extra click swayed choices toward visible options.

S008.title: FTC inquiry into AI chatbots acting as companions
S008.claim: FTC sought information on monetization, inputs, negative impacts, disclosures, and data practices from seven firms.

S009.title: International AI Safety Report 2026 extended summary
S009.claim: Systemic risks include labour-market impacts and human autonomy; AI can shape beliefs/preferences and automation bias.

S010.title: OpenAI — Our Structure
S010.claim: Foundation appoints all OpenAI Group directors and can replace them; Sam Altman is one Foundation director.
